description: Documentation dependency registry. Hand-editable source of truth. Read by pre-write-guard.sh and librarian session-close. Mirrored into state/manifests/librarian-manifest.json -> doc_dependencies on each /librarian full run. Cascade registry consumed by pre-write-guard.sh + librarian session-close. The entities{} block is a declarative entity-mirror registry; per-type parity is enforced independently by trinity-drift-detect (plan) + memory-hygiene (memory); no generic entity-parity capability ships.

_path_placeholders._description: Path placeholders are substituted at install time. Foundation-repo ships paths in this parameterized form; install.sh resolves each placeholder against the adopter's environment.
_path_placeholders.{vault_root}: Adopter's vault root (per onboarding wizard archetype)

schema_notes.rename_history: Append-only audit trail of renames that have touched an entry's primary / mirrors[]. Each row: {"from": "<old-path>", "to": "<new-path>", "at": "<ISO8601>", "commit": "<sha>"}. Populated by rename-detect.sh at librarian session-close. Forward-only: no historical backfill. Empty array means no known renames since instrumentation landed.

_rules.source: governance/doc-dependencies.json :: _rules (SoT). R-48 is the broken-wikilink Tier-1 advisory enforced at hooks/pre-write-guard.sh; declared here so it is visible to the rules-index.
_rules.rule_text: A file written with wikilink reference(s) [[target]] / [[target|alias]] to a non-existent target SHOULD surface a write-time advisory naming the broken target(s). ADVISORY — never blocks the write; complements the post-hoc wikilink-repair capability. R-48 is the broken-wikilink write-time advisory (Tier 1).
_rules.failure_mode: A wikilink to a non-existent target lands silently; the vault navigation graph carries a dangling edge that the reader only discovers on click. Advisory: write proceeds; operator told the broken target(s) + pointed at wikilink-repair or to create the target file if intended.

_rules.rule_text: When an upstream document declared in this registry's entries[]/entities[] is edited, its declared downstream consumers/mirrors should be cascaded. ADVISORY — surfaced at write-time and at librarian session-close; never a write-time DENY. R-54 is the canonical doc-dep cascade ID; the hook header label is R-54 (renamed from R-07).
_rules.failure_mode: An upstream doc changes but its declared downstream mirrors drift. Advisory only — vault-writer fan-out is the forward path; R-54 is the thin/legacy cascade rail kept for the registry-declared edges.
_rules._framing: thin/legacy — the vault-writer fan-out (R-58 / writer-reference contract) is the FORWARD path; R-54 covers the registry-declared cascade edges only.

entities._comment: Entity parity registry. Each entity declares a canonical source path template with {name} placeholder, an instance-enumerator (glob/file-list/directory-index), the canonical field to compare, and mirrors with strict/presence-only flags. Declarative entity-mirror registry; per-type parity enforced independently by trinity-drift-detect (plan) + memory-hygiene (memory); no generic entity-parity capability ships.

mirrors.notes: Vault design spec for the skill. Present for most runtime skills; absent for a minority of backend-only skills.
Master catalog row. Description column is paraphrased-by-design (summary, not mirror). Presence-only check.
Plan manifest. Optional because pre-manifest plans may not carry one; when present, top-level status must match spec frontmatter.
MEMORY.md index entry. Summary after em-dash is paraphrased for scan-readability. Presence-only check.
